questions.qtext: Which of the following option(s) is/are correct regarding assumptions made in working stress method?

options.text: Modular ratio m = partially accounts for long-term creep effects.
All tensile stresses are taken by concrete only
Modulus of elasticity of concrete is constant at all stresses

questions.solution:
(a, c, d)
All tensile stresses are assumed to be taken by the reinforcement alone and none by the concrete.
This means that while calculating the moment of resistance of the beam, the contribution of the
concrete below neutral axis is to be completely neglected.
